purpose: Independently test the signed exact-syntax time-identity diagnostic, inspect its population-model integration and verify the interpretation of the retained development counterexample without adding scientific authority.

scope.authority: research-contract/1.0 sections 5.3 and 5.4; existing model/dependence-adequacy inquiry and D084 implementation boundary

findings.finding: For the supported ordered syntax, paired feature offsets identify k = condition_offset - outcome_offset - horizon. The resulting statement is C_t = Y_(t+k), conditional on valid exactly bound reference-program semantics and jointly observable values.
findings.evidence: Independent positive, negative and zero-offset cases, nested lags, distributed feature lags and exact feature/catalog/literal/operator mismatches.
findings.qualification: The diagnostic does not independently compile or certify types/features. Removing lag nodes for comparison does not preserve intermediate-row requirements, missingness, availability cutoffs or eligibility, and is not an executable AST rewrite. Unsupported syntax, feature-free constants and absent matches do not establish independence.

findings.finding: Observed partners are selected by the same instrument and exact timestamp offset, including retained known values on currently ineligible rows. Missing-pair buckets are disjoint, and equal/unequal counts are retained separately from both-eligible counts.
findings.evidence: Independent two-instrument, missing-middle-row, one-sided and both-sided missingness, zero-support and deliberately inconsistent observed-value cases.
findings.qualification: An absent partner is absent from the retained case grid, including a possible partial prefix. Zero comparisons provide no empirical confirmation, and a structural match may coexist with observed disagreements without silently discarding them.

findings.finding: build_model adds source_process_scope and source_identity_preservation metadata. It does not change scenario feasibility, probabilities, effect truth, generator masks/RNG, MODEL_SPECIFIED status, N_min or scientific classification authority.
findings.evidence: Two-file production review and actual retained old/current source comparison with fresh current replay.
findings.qualification: New model hashes and the synthetic identities derived from them change. Historical capsules continue to execute their retained source; no old result is rewritten. The integration is descriptive and does not enforce or claim original-process adequacy.

findings.finding: The prescribed one-day BTCUSDT development probe has C_t = Y_(t-2) under its original AST. The independently recomputed timestamp join has 94 equal observed pairs and zero unequal pairs, with 92 pairs eligible on both sides. One predeclared estimator-only null world violates that source identity on 42 of 91 comparable pairs.
findings.evidence: SHA-verified development case stream, independently repeated timestamp/instrument join, frozen profile and actual_scope.py generation/legacy-comparison/replay observation.
findings.qualification: This is a constructive counterexample to guaranteed preservation by that declared response/mask generator. It is not a fitted market law, frequency estimate over selected seeds, independent market confirmation, rejection of estimator-only stress or a requirement that stationary-bootstrap block concatenations preserve original raw-process identities.

red_green_history.outcome: Initial baseline run contained the absent new-module errors and an independent test preparation error: the existing pending/review result was incorrectly expected to be EVALUATION_GAP.
red_green_history.correction: After inspecting outcomes.py, the assertion was corrected to the existing INFORMATION_GAP status and dependency_review_required reason. No production behavior or scientific expectation was changed. This failed preparation remains retained.

red_green_history.outcome: Corrected independent tests fail on the missing source_process_scope module in an isolated extraction of source-before.zip; the shared working tree is not reverted or modified.

additional_records_inspected.qualification: Parent-run combined suite includes the same 14 independent tests; it is not 17 additional distinct tests.
Parent-run focused regression record inspected; no full-repository inference.

Parent-run probe procedure and output independently inspected. Read-only owned development registry access and blob hashes precede three isolated source executions: old generation, current generation and separate current replay.

documentation_review.outcome: Descriptions agree with the reviewed code and observations. They distinguish the prescribed engineering probe from free discovery, mathematical value identity from missingness/eligibility, estimator-only stress from original-process adequacy, and software evidence from scientific admission.
documentation_review.publication_adjustment: The four changed Markdown files outside the evidence folder were normalized to the existing LF policy. The checkpoint description also discloses the historical proposal-only verifier failure and its retained scope analysis. This documentation-only review update leaves all previous production/test hashes, runtime observations, red/green records and review boundaries unchanged.

historical_check_disclosure.disposition: The retained checker enforces its historical proposal-only file inventory. The inspected classification procedure reads the pre-edit Git commit and confirms that those inventory requirements already fail before this change. The actual failed check is retained and is not represented as a pass; it is not a current implementation release gate. No historical checker was changed.

methodological_reference.title: Using simulation studies to evaluate statistical methods
methodological_reference.use: Primary methodological support for separating simulation aims, generating mechanisms and estimands. It is not authority for a new project threshold, market model or admission rule.

remaining_uncertainty: No suitable original-process generator or fitted dependence law is established by this diagnostic.
Stationarity, selection, missingness, original-process adequacy, actual information target, power and complete scientific calibration remain unverified.
This bounded syntax recognizer is not general symbolic equivalence or an independent feature/compiler certificate.
The observed prescribed development day is not a scientific market finding or evidence that unrestricted autonomous research has completed.
The independent suite and inspected parent records do not establish a full-repository regression result or production deployment/security certification.
No timing or performance improvement follows from these checks.
next_action: Develop a reviewable source-specific model/profile that states which dependencies are preserved and the scope of its conclusions before the actual information/calibration campaign. Preserve declared estimator-only stress as a separate bounded purpose, free hypothesis invention, historical source replay and existing scientific change control.
